TNK PROGRESSION — 1.1.9

Minecraft 1.21.1 · NeoForge 21.1.262+ · Java 21

Title and prestige badges

  • Refresh all 87 title badges with native pixel lettering, brighter text, and 25 saturated colors. Owner uses the Kingdoms color #A85571.
  • Levels 101–104 share an Amethyst badge style. Level 105 and Eternal Sovereign fade from amber gold through rose to purple.

Quest title passives

  • All 28 Completionist, questline, and boss titles can now be equipped in the passive slot. Each has bonuses tied to its unlock, such as Forgehand’s mining speed and Dreadbane’s attack damage and armor.
  • Existing saves receive the new defaults while retaining custom perks and explicit empty lists. Title ownership and cosmetic selections carry over.
  • Eternal Sovereign’s level-105 bonuses remain permanent and work alongside the selected passive title.

Update the server and clients together.
